q: National Scholarship Portal NSP kya hai
a: National Scholarship Portal ek single platform hai jahan aap sab scholarships apply kar sakte ho. Website hai scholarships.gov.in. Pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means — sab yahan apply hota hai.

q: Scholarship ke liye kaunse documents chahiye
a: Zaroori documents: Aadhaar card, income certificate, caste certificate agar lagu ho, bank passbook, last year marksheet, passport photo. School ya college ka bonafide certificate bhi chahiye.

q: NSP scholarship last date kya hai
a: Har saal October-November ke aas paas registration band hota hai. Current cycle ke liye scholarships.gov.in pe exact date check karo. Jaldi apply karo, kyunki last week mein portal slow ho jata hai.

q: NSP pe kaunsi scholarship choose karu
a: Agar aap OBC SC ST se ho aur family income 2.5 lakh se kam hai to post-matric SC ST scholarship. Merit basis pe aapko merit-cum-means mil sakta hai. NSP pe filters use karke apne states schemes bhi dekho.

q: PM Scholarship PM Suraksha Bandhan kya hai
a: PM Suraksha Bandhan Armed Forces aur Assam Rifles ke ex-servicemen ke wards ke liye scholarship hai. Puri details KSB.nic.in pe hain, NSP se bhi apply ho sakta hai.

q: Mera NSP application reject ho gaya kyun
a: Common reasons: bank account Aadhaar se link nahi hai, documents blur upload kiye, income certificate stale hai, ya institute ne verify nahi kiya. Portal pe reason milega, correct karke resubmit kar sakte ho.

q: Bank account Aadhaar se kaise link kare
a: Apni bank branch mein Aadhaar card aur passbook le kar jao, Aadhaar DBT linkage form bharo. Ya India Post payment bank se bhi link kar sakte ho. 5-7 din mein DBT active ho jata hai.

q: Scholarship help ke liye kahan contact kare
a: NSP ke liye helpline hai 0120-6619540. Email helpdesk@nsp.gov.in. State scholarship ke liye apne state education office se contact karo.
Har saal renewal ke liye NSP pe login karke Renew option select karo. Last year ke marks aur bank details verify karo, naye documents upload karo, phir submit.
Income certificate Tehsildar office, e-District portal, ya CSC centre se banta hai. Online apply karo, 7-15 din mein mil jayega. 6 month se purana certificate mat le aao.

q: Mera scholarship status check kaise kare
a: NSP pe login karo, My Applications pe click karo. Status dikhega: submitted, verified by institute, approved, ya failed. Payment status pe PFMS portal bhi check kar sakte ho.

q: NSP versus state scholarship mein kya difference hai
a: NSP central aur state dono schemes ka unified portal hai. Central schemes SC/ST OBC minority ke liye. State apni schemes alag se bhi chalata hai — dono mein apply kar sakte ho agar eligible ho.
